mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, title, chapter_no, content, word_count, version_no, status, created_at, updated_at FROM story_chapter WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY chapter_no ASC
SELECT id, project_id, title, chapter_no, content, word_count, version_no, status, created_at, updated_at FROM story_chapter WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_chapter (project_id, title, chapter_no, content, word_count, version_no, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{chapterNo}, #{content}, #{wordCount}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE story_chapter SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, word_count = #{wordCount}, version_no = #{versionNo}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
